final_topology.title: High Availability Branch Office
final_topology.description: A branch office network with emphasis on high availability and voice service continuity, connected to the central data center with a primary link and public phone network failover for voice services.
final_topology.topology_summary: The topology includes a primary connection to the central data center and a secondary connection to the public phone network for voice failover. It supports SIP-based voice traffic and includes centralized user authentication and network traffic logging.

controls.title: Establish and Maintain Detailed Enterprise Asset Inventory
controls.evidence: The topology includes an Asset Management System (n24) that tracks and manages assets across various zones, indicating a detailed and maintained inventory.

controls.title: Document Data Flows
controls.evidence: The topology includes several data flow links, but there is no explicit documentation of these data flows. A human review is needed to confirm if the data flows are documented.
controls.missing_reason: No explicit documentation of data flows.
controls.repair_suggestion: Add a node or link that explicitly represents data flow documentation.

controls.title: Segment Data Processing and Storage Based on Sensitivity
controls.evidence: The topology includes multiple zones (e.g., z1, z5, z6) that are segmented, and there are specific links and nodes (e.g., n11, n20) that enforce security policies, indicating segmentation based on data sensitivity.

controls.title: Implement and Manage a Firewall on Servers
controls.evidence: The topology includes a Firewall - Server (n11) that is linked to the server (n4), indicating that a firewall is implemented and managed on the server.

controls.title: Configure Trusted DNS Servers on Enterprise Assets
controls.evidence: The topology includes a DNS Server (n12) that is linked to the internal network (n10), indicating that trusted DNS servers are configured on enterprise assets.

controls.title: Require MFA for Remote Network Access
controls.evidence: The topology includes an MFA/Identity Node (n13) that is linked to the firewall (n3), indicating that MFA is required for remote network access.

controls.title: Use DNS Filtering Services
controls.evidence: The topology includes a DNS Filtering Node (n14) that is linked to the internal network (n10), indicating that DNS filtering services are used.

controls.title: Maintain and Enforce Network-Based URL Filters
controls.evidence: The topology includes a Web Proxy (n15) that is linked to the internal network (n10), indicating that network-based URL filters are enforced.

controls.title: Establish and Maintain a Secure Network Architecture
controls.evidence: The topology includes multiple zones, firewalls, and security nodes (e.g., n11, n17, n18, n19, n20) that enforce security policies, indicating a secure network architecture.

controls.title: Securely Manage Network Infrastructure
controls.evidence: The topology includes IaC Management (n25) that is linked to various nodes, indicating that network infrastructure is securely managed using IaC.

controls.title: Centralize Network Authentication, Authorization, and Auditing (AAA)
controls.evidence: The topology includes an AAA Server (n22) that is linked to the central firewall (n16), indicating centralized network AAA.

controls.title: Ensure Remote Devices Utilize a VPN and are Connecting to an Enterprise’s AAA Infrastructure
controls.evidence: The topology includes a Central Firewall (n16) that is linked to the primary and secondary routers (n1, n2), indicating that remote devices utilize a VPN and connect to the enterprise’s AAA infrastructure.

controls.title: Establish and Maintain Dedicated Computing Resources for All Administrative Work
controls.evidence: The topology includes a Dedicated Admin Workstation (n21) that is linked to the central firewall (n16), indicating dedicated computing resources for administrative work.

controls.title: Deploy a Network Intrusion Detection Solution
controls.evidence: The topology includes a NIDS (n17) that is linked to the central firewall (n16), indicating a deployed network intrusion detection solution.

controls.title: Perform Traffic Filtering Between Network Segments
controls.evidence: The topology includes multiple firewalls (n3, n11, n16) and security nodes (n17, n18, n19, n20) that perform traffic filtering between network segments.

controls.title: Manage Access Control for Remote Assets
controls.evidence: The topology includes an MFA/Identity Node (n13) and an AAA Server (n22) that manage access control for remote assets.

controls.title: Collect Network Traffic Flow Logs
controls.evidence: The topology includes a SIEM (n6) that is linked to the firewall (n3) and other nodes, indicating that network traffic flow logs are collected.

controls.title: Deploy a Network Intrusion Prevention Solution
controls.evidence: The topology includes a NIPS (n18) that is linked to the central firewall (n16), indicating a deployed network intrusion prevention solution.

controls.title: Deploy Port-Level Access Control
controls.evidence: The topology includes a NAC (n19) that is linked to the internal network (n10), indicating deployed port-level access control.

controls.title: Perform Application Layer Filtering
controls.evidence: The topology includes an Application Firewall (n20) that is linked to the internal network (n10), indicating application layer filtering.

controls.title: Separate Production and Non-Production Systems
controls.evidence: The topology includes a Non-Production Zone (z5) that is peered with the Branch Office (z1), indicating separation of production and non-production systems.

controls.title: Perform Periodic External Penetration Tests
controls.evidence: The topology includes a Penetration Testing Node (n23) that is linked to the central firewall (n16), indicating that periodic external penetration tests are performed.

findings_before.title: empty_zone_without_node
findings_before.missing_reason: Zone z5 has no concrete node assigned to it.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add one representative concrete node in this zone and connect it with node_links to the nearest hub, firewall, router, or management/security node.

findings_before.title: ig3_missing_ig2_zone_semantics
findings_before.missing_reason: IG3 topology removed or failed to preserve IG2 zone semantics.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add the missing IG2 zone semantics to IG3 as preserved or stricter zones, with representative nodes and concrete node_links. IG3 may add controls but must not reduce segmentation.

findings_before.title: Establish and Maintain Detailed Enterprise Asset Inventory
findings_before.evidence: The topology includes various nodes and zones, but there is no explicit evidence of an asset inventory system or process.
findings_before.missing_reason: No explicit asset inventory system or process is shown in the topology.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add a node representing an asset management system and links to all other nodes to indicate asset tracking.

findings_before.title: Securely Manage Network Infrastructure
findings_before.evidence: The topology includes various network devices (e.g., routers, switches, firewalls) but does not explicitly show secure management practices like IaC or secure protocols.
findings_before.missing_reason: No explicit evidence of secure management practices like IaC or secure protocols.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add nodes representing IaC tools and links indicating secure protocol usage.

findings_before.title: Perform Periodic External Penetration Tests
findings_before.evidence: The topology includes a Penetration Testing Node (n23) with a management link (nl25) to the central firewall (n16), but there is no explicit evidence of periodic testing.
findings_before.missing_reason: No explicit evidence of periodic external penetration testing.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add a node representing a penetration testing schedule and links to the Penetration Testing Node.

findings_before.title: Document Data Flows
findings_before.evidence: The topology does not explicitly show or label data flow documentation.
findings_before.missing_reason: No explicit data flow documentation is present in the topology.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add explicit data flow documentation to the topology, including service provider data flows.
